card.name: Start of 'secret-' and similar medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical word that is split up, mostly 'secret' in secretion, secreted or secretagogue. It also fires on a few other word starts like 'intoxicated', 'ALT' and 'MAV'.
